notes.title: ANOINTED GAMEPLAY UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]The Anointed: David Saves Keilah[/b]
IMD is proud to announce this major update to The Anointed: DSK. 
In this update, players will have improved combat, stealth and controls. This follows are goal to always provide the best experience possible, as we progress towards the full title, The Anointed: Heart of David.

[u]Combat Upgrade[/u]
The player will have a more balanced interaction with enemies and greater ability to promote through the levels of combinations.

[u]Stealth Upgrade[/u]
Stealth is now more enjoyable and a vital element of saving Keilah from the Philistines. Especially, those mean spear-throwing guys on the roof. 

[u]Controller Support[/u]
Players will now be able to use gamepads, and will have configurations for both Keyboard/mouse and controllers. 

In addition to the above upgrades, there are new features like Pick-axe climbing, Ziplines, and new horses to ride. IMD will continue to improve The Anointed and wishes all players a good time while we work hard to make each iteration better.

notes.title: ANNIVERSARY EDITION - THE ANOINTED: DAVID SAVES KEILAH
notes.content:
[b]The Anniversary of The Anointed: DSK[/b] original release is a big occasion - and deserves a BIG update. Here it is… IMD is proud to announce this FREE & new version of DSK, which includes new levels, more quests, and advanced combat, which David uses to protect sheep from lions and bears and to defeat the Philistine invaders. Now, the player can experience how David’s story starts and how this unlikely, under appreciated young person became The Anointed.

In addition to the previous episode, David Saves Keilah - the player will find:
[list]
[*] Two New Levels and Training Areas
[*] Advanced Combat and Combo System
[*] More Cutscenes, Voice overs, and Story 
[*] Improved Stealth and Strategic Conflicts
[*] Special Abilities: Holy Vision and SMITE
[*] In Game User Guide and Tutorials
[*] Free-Play Mode with Hidden Areas
[*] Swimming: David and Horse
[/list]
This new and improved update to DSK will enhance the player’s experience. There is much more gameplay, and almost double the play time. 

The Anointed: DSK is a complete episode of the upcoming title, Heart Of David. The Anointed franchise will continue to be developed, and updates to the DSK episode will continue as new features are completed. This is only the first of many updates. Supporters and Players are very important to IMD and this update exemplifies the effort to make quality games and provide those updates free (always). 

Thank you for the continued support. Learn more about IMD by visiting www.IMDinteractive.org

notes.title: First Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
- Save bug on ESC fixed
- Gameplay/Notification improvements
- Lighting improvements
- Video settings working again
- Render/Material Pool Size (game should look much better on min spec machines)
- Cutscene improvements
- Other small improvements

[h3]Note:[/h3]
Thank you to everyone that's been taking the time to play the game and give feedback! We are a small team, but we have been listening and hope these changes make the game that much more fun for you! 
Be sure to see our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1942530/view/3281459272263782468]update post[/url] for some helpful tips.

notes.title: The Anointed: DSK - Update
notes.content:
This first episode of David's story - DSK - released with a few issues. 
We are working on major updates for the next title but will provide an update soon that will address:
- Save bug on ESC
- Gameplay/Notifications
- Render/Material Pool Size (min specs)

The combat, AI, and Interactions will continue to evolve, albeit our focus is on delivering a faithful representation of David's story first. We appreciate the stress test and feedback - thank you.

Tips:
Follow the story (1 Sam 23) and intuitive prompts.
Use only Spacebar to mantle or finish climbing up, and combine with directional only when reaching.
Stealth and passive play will always be more rewarding (characteristics of David).
Collecting, and Reading scrolls, watching Videos and using Stealth gains Righteousness(Purple bar).
Use V in Stealth situations to use Holy Vision (Righteousness) and improve strategy.

We are a small team and this is the first episode of David's story. We appreciate your interest and hope you continue to follow our efforts to provide a game that is both fun and informative.
